scripts.dev: npm run public:portal && SITE_TARGET=portal astro dev
scripts.dev:recht: npm run public:recht && SITE_TARGET=law astro dev
scripts.content:check: node scripts/import-normen.mjs --source-dir Gesetze --strict --quiet && node scripts/revosax-snapshot.mjs audit && node scripts/audit-consolidation.mjs --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-organization.ts && node scripts/check-content.mjs && node scripts/check-topic-coverage.mjs && node scripts/knowledge.mjs check
scripts.check:portal: npm run public:portal && SITE_TARGET=portal astro check
scripts.check:recht: npm run public:recht && SITE_TARGET=law astro check
scripts.check: npm run check:portal && npm run check:recht
scripts.build:portal: npm run public:portal && SITE_TARGET=portal astro build && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs portal
scripts.build:recht: npm run public:recht && SITE_TARGET=law astro build && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs law
scripts.build: npm run build:portal && npm run build:recht
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && playwright test tests/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:quality: npm run build && playwright test tests/quality.spec.ts --config=playwright.quality.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:browsers: npm run build && playwright test tests/browser-smoke.spec.ts --config=playwright.quality.config.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:portal && npm run deploy:recht
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:portal:staging && npm run deploy:recht:staging
